controls.label: Brightness
controls.help: Raises every fitted tone-curve knot to the power 2^(-0.8 v). Black and white stay fixed.

controls.label: Contrast
controls.help: S-curve around 0.5 on the fitted tone-curve knots with exponent 2^(0.8 v). Black, mid-grey and white stay fixed.

controls.label: Warm balance
controls.help: Red curve knots to the power 2^(-0.3 v), blue knots to 2^(0.3 v). Green, black and white stay fixed.

controls.label: Overall chroma
controls.help: Multiplies the tone-dependent chroma gains and the per-hue chroma band by 2^v, scaling OKLab chroma uniformly.

controls.label: Shadow chroma
controls.help: Multiplies the fitted chroma gain at L = 0 by 2^v.

controls.label: Highlight chroma
controls.help: Multiplies the fitted chroma gain at L = 1 by 2^v.

controls.label: Crosstalk strength
controls.help: Blends the fitted linear-light crosstalk matrix toward identity: I + v (M - I). Rows are still renormalised so white stays white.

controls.label: Hue chroma correction
controls.help: Scales the fitted per-hue-band chroma corrections.

controls.label: Hue rotation correction
controls.help: Scales the fitted per-hue-band hue rotations.

controls.label: Hue lightness correction
controls.help: Scales the fitted per-hue-band lightness corrections.

controls.label: Halation
controls.help: Sets the highlight glow amount; only bright areas bloom.

controls.label: Softness
controls.help: Sets the Gaussian softness stage amount. Its radius scales with resolution, so previews understate it.

controls.label: Grain amount
controls.help: Sets the recipe grain amount; the seed's per-shot grain jitter is still added on top.

controls.label: Grain size
controls.help: Sets the grain stage size. Grain is resolution-dependent, so previews are approximate.

controls.label: Light-leak strength
controls.help: Sets the recipe leak strength; a seeded leak keeps its per-shot strength scale. Zero disables the leak.

controls.label: Light leak
controls.help: Baseline lets the seed decide. On/off overrides it. Changing leak occurrence changes later random draws, including grain.

controls.label: Date stamp
controls.help: Baseline draws the seven-segment stamp from the capture context. Off removes the stamp.
